title: 7 Signs a Godly Man Has Actually Learned to Delay Gratification
caption:
Self-control isn't a personality trait. It's a thousand small delays nobody sees.

The guy who lets the phone ring out, waits on the purchase, and saves the hard conversation for face to face isn't repressed. He's the one thing running his life is actually him.

Wanting something badly and still saying not yet is a discipline, not a deficiency.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #discipline
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
